limits.en: Most Fredo6 plugins (FredoScale, FredoCorner, FredoBend, Curviloft, etc.) are free; only a few (FredoPortrait, FredoSpline) are marked licensed/paid

keyLimits.en: Most of the 40+ plugins in the bundle (FredoScale, FredoCorner, Curviloft, etc.) are free to download

addOns.en: FredoPortrait and FredoSpline require a separate paid license; exact prices not published on the listing page

cautions.en: The 'bundle' is not a single purchase: it is a collection of 40+ individually distributed plugins, most free, a couple paid, requiring the shared LibFredo6 library.

capabilities.en: Grouped distribution of 40+ specialized SketchUp modeling extensions (FredoScale, FredoCorner, FredoBend, Curviloft, BezierSpline, etc.)
Covers geometric transformation, curve/spline drawing, and toolbar management workflows

limitations.en: Not a unified product: each plugin is installed and updated separately from SketchUcation
Requires the shared LibFredo6 library (SketchUp 2017+) as infrastructure, not a standalone tool

reason.en: Host application these plugins extend; some equivalent modeling tools are native in Pro

unknowns: Exact prices for the paid plugins (FredoPortrait, FredoSpline) not shown on the SketchUcation listing
No single official 'bundle' purchase page found; distribution is per-plugin
